findings.rule: Hole depth must be compatible with the part envelope and standard small-hole drilling/tapping capability.
findings.reasoning: F4 calls an Ø4.2 hole 50 mm deep for an M5 tap. That is about 12xD drilling and 10xD tapping, and the 50 mm depth also exceeds the 40 mm linear dimension D7, so the feature appears impossible unless it is a through/angled hole not specified.
findings.correction: Reduce the hole/thread depth to the functional requirement, make it through if intended, correct the conflicting length/depth dimensions, and specify gun drilling/peck tapping if the depth must remain.

findings.rule: Title-block heat treatment must be consistent with or reference heat-treatment notes.
findings.reasoning: The heat_treatment field is '---' while N1 requires case hardening to 55-60 HRC with case depth 0.8-2 mm. This conflict can cause the required heat treatment to be missed.
findings.correction: Enter the required case-hardening specification in the heat_treatment field or add an explicit reference to N1; remove the '---' entry.

findings.rule: Functional threaded features should include thread designation, tolerance/fit class, and thread depth.
findings.reasoning: F4 indicates an M5 tap, but the drawing only gives the Ø4.2 drill diameter and 50 mm depth; no thread tolerance class or effective thread depth is specified.
findings.correction: Add a complete thread callout, for example M5 x 0.8 - 6H, with the required thread depth and blind/through status.
